text_block_list.name: Fishing Tournament MC
text_block_list.text:
And so, at this time, we proudly open the 38th Fishing Cup!
Best of luck out there, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
......ughhhhh, I'm catching nothingggg!
Maybe there aren't even any fish here?! Ughhh......

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Idea☆ Hey, hey, Ai-chan♡
Let's switch spots! You're not catching anything either, right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You're right......
But I think I'll stick it out here a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh. For reals? Why's that?
Wouldn't it be better to switch it up hard and fast?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't think rushing will do much good.
——All that matters is winning in the end. Let's take it slow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, ohh, someone's in full serious-mode.
Looks like Sei-chan can't afford to slack off either, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Glug, glug... phew! Lunch break's over!
I wonder which spot I should target this afternoon......

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ......Hey, Ai-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Like, um...... this might just be me reading too much into it, but.
......Did you figure something out?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Rather than "figured out," it'd be more accurate to say something clicked.
But, yeah... fufu. I feel like I understand, just a little.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
What resting really means.
And what kind of "rest" becomes the right use of my time.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Um... could you tell me?
What, and how, clicked for you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! After all, I only learned it from Bright-san myself——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
We've been treating rest as "standing still," haven't we?
But that's not it. It never was.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Rest is "easing your pace"... and actually, even while you're resting, you're moving forward, little by little. Toward your destination.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I see......? ...Yeah, yeah......

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ——Ah, I get it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's just like manga! You lay down the storyboard on pure momentum first! Then—— you leave it be, and the clearheaded me of the next day picks it apart!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And then you can draw something good. Stepping away from what you made, getting some objective distance on it... that matters. Yeah. So rest——

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
——is "revision."
For me to draw the absolute best story!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I see... I see, I see! If resting is one of the "necessary steps" for drawing a masterpiece, then——

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oryaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Fishing Tournament MC
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, and right there Kiseki reels in her 40th fish!
The battle at the top is really heating up!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Tch... to think that just a change of mindset, and this much...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Ai-chan. For talking it out with me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I got to throw myself into "playing" this hard!
I'm resting properly!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ——With this, I can beat you, Ai-chan.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......! ......Fufu. Kiseki-chan, just now...
you asked me for advice because you wanted to beat me?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
......Nah. It's a pretty pathetic story, honestly, like, really!!
I'm about as far from a protagonist as you can get, is the thing... ugh...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
......But.
Back then, I decided.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Always — to you, who's always ahead of me.
To Almond Eye, who wears the protagonist role better than I do——

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'd catch up to you, by any means necessary.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......Fufu. In that case, same here.
I'll take it right back from you.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu... now, take this—— this is my Wide Tornado Casting——!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
What kind of finishing move is that?! ......No, I'm not done yet!
I've still got my first-half advantage!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Bring it, Almond Eye!
Today, I'm wrenching one win away from you!!

text_block_list.name: Fishing Tournament MC
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the winner is Seiun Sky!!
As a bonus prize, she'll be receiving locally-harvested nori seaweed!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hi hi, Sei-chan here. Yay☆

text_block_list.name: Kiseki & Ai
text_block_list.text:
Arrgh, so frustrating——!!
Ugh, it stings......!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Man, that stung! But it was fun!
When's the last time I went that hard at just playing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm glad. It seems the two of you managed a meaningful rest, after alll.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So——tomorrow too!
Please take a breather with us again!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This summer, to become a me who can win even more——
I want to go all-out on both training and rest!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Good thing I leaned on Sky-senpai and Bright-senpai.
Or wait, maybe me leaning on my senpais was the genius move here☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Kay, kay! See you tomorrow!
Let's meet up right outside the dorms tomorrow! Then let's do something☆

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. "Something" being what?
You should at least decide what we're doing ahead of time——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
......? Sky-sama?
Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
......Hm? Ah, no, nothing?
It's just——

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Just thinking how serious everyone is.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hm, a call? ......From President Rudolf?!
Hello, hello! ......Yes. Yes...——Eh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: A mock race? ......With the President and the others!!?
